records.text: The COVID-19 vaccination effort did not create a vaccine that guarded people against COVID-19.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Go back to COVID, right? Oh, stay at home, save lives. What were they actually doing? We don't know what they were doing. We know what they weren't doing. They weren't creating a vaccine that guarded you against COVID.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. Current WHO and CDC evidence shows COVID-19 vaccines reduce severe disease, hospitalization, and death, although protection against infection and transmission is incomplete and wanes. The blanket claim that vaccination created no vaccine that guarded people against COVID-19 is false.
